name: Implicit Tree via Graph Properties
description: Frame the problem as a general network connectivity task (Steiner Tree on a graph), removing all explicit mentions of "unique paths" or "trees". Provide the structural guarantee solely through the numerical relationship m = n - 1 and the fact that all modules are reachable from each other using the available conduits. This forces models to deduce that the input is a tree from Euler's formula for graphs, rather than pattern-matching the "unique path" description to trigger a tree-pruning algorithm.
